external_entities.name: insurance partner
external_entities.description: Three insurance partners that provide daily claim-record extracts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Three insurance partners drop a daily extract for us.
external_entities.notes: Represents the three partners collectively; the text does not distinguish them by name.

external_entities.name: analyst
external_entities.description: Analysts who query the warehouse directly.
external_entities.notes: The text refers to analysts in the plural; no individual analysts are distinguished.

processes.name: Airflow scheduler
processes.description: Scheduler that lists and reads the landing bucket and triggers a Spark transform job.
processes.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network wakes up at 02:00, lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there.
processes.notes: Airflow keeps connection strings and partner keys in its metadata database.

processes.name: Spark transform job
processes.description: Transform job that normalizes claim records and loads them into BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network. The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.

data_stores.name: landing bucket
data_stores.description: Bucket receiving daily extract files from insurance partners.
data_stores.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.
data_stores.notes: The submitter does not know how the landing bucket is encrypted: "I don't know how the landing bucket is encrypted". Both the encryption mechanism and whether encryption is enabled are therefore unknown.

data_stores.name: Airflow metadata database
data_stores.description: Airflow database storing connection strings and partner keys.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.
data_stores.notes: The submitter does not know whether the Airflow metadata database is encrypted at rest: "I don't know ... whether the Airflow metadata database is encrypted at rest." Both the encryption mechanism and whether encryption is enabled are therefore unknown.

data_stores.name: BigQuery
data_stores.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.
data_stores.notes: Analysts query the warehouse directly, and member-identifying columns have not been split out.

data_flows.name: push files
data_flows.description: Insurance partners push daily claim-record extracts into the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.
data_flows.data_description: Claim records with member names and dates of birth

data_flows.name: read files
data_flows.description: Airflow lists and reads files from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network wakes up at 02:00, lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there.
data_flows.notes: The scheduler does not check that a file came from the partner whose folder it landed in.

data_flows.name: store credentials
data_flows.description: Airflow keeps connection strings and partner keys in its metadata database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.

data_flows.name: trigger transform
data_flows.description: The Airflow scheduler triggers a Spark transform job for each file.
data_flows.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network.

data_flows.name: load records
data_flows.description: The Spark transform job loads normalized claim records into BigQuery.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.
data_flows.notes: Nothing validates the row contents beyond the schema.

data_flows.name: query warehouse
data_flows.source_excerpt: Analysts query the warehouse directly. They are on the warehouse network and authenticate with SSO, but the grant is dataset-wide — we have not split member-identifying columns out.
data_flows.notes: The grant is dataset-wide and member-identifying columns have not been split out.
data_flows.data_description: Warehouse claim records, including member-identifying columns
